backbone: POWO/WCVP 2026 accessed 2026-10-25, corroborated by ITIS taxon nomenclature and Smithsonian specimen label; primary 1932 protologue/type not independently examined.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Muhlenbergia x involuta / Muhlenbergia involuta Swallen
scientific_decisions.reason: ASCII x and historical unmarked name in ITIS/collections refer to the same named taxon in this context; do not create duplicate accepted learner entries. Preserve original source spelling verbatim.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Automatically merge Muhlenbergia × involuta into M. lindheimeri
scientific_decisions.reason: Reject merger: POWO accepts the hybrid and both parent species separately.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Automatically merge Muhlenbergia × involuta into M. reverchonii
scientific_decisions.reason: Reject merger: hybrid formula and accepted parent do not establish synonymy or duplicate identity.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Existing canonical learner source-labelled photographs and historical comparison plate
scientific_decisions.reason: Institutional or source-level labels and comparison images are not voucher-verified determinations of the individual plants in the learner. Preserve provisional hybrid identity and any existing visual/photo holds.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Individual plant hybrid ancestry and source accession
scientific_decisions.reason: Accepted hybrid formula does not prove parentage of any particular observed plant. Keep voucher, specimen identity, and genetic-parentage holds until directly corroborated.

scientific_decisions.source_name: Original 1932 type/protologue and later hybrid reinterpretation
scientific_decisions.reason: POWO supplies original publication citation and modern accepted hybrid concept; original type material/protologue not independently examined in this run. Do not claim type-level resolution or reinterpret specimen labels beyond their evidence.
